Description - GET /box/LoginFromBox

The generic default web-box-service-url = http://%1/box/LoginFromBox?t=%2&returnUrl=/ from the default config (defconf.ini, also used by the configurator). The chomikuj.pl brand overlay replaces it, so the client does not use it. Live: 404 on chomikuj.pl, 302 to /Error404.aspx on box.chomikuj.pl.

Client vs live - discrepancies

Security notes - findings that concern GET /box/LoginFromBox

  • C-06 Medium The session token travels in clear in every SOAP body and as a URL query parameter (LoginFromBox?t=), where it becomes a full web session (ChomikSession) and can leak via logs, history and proxies.

From x-security-notes in the spec. Ratings and scope are explained on Security & privacy.
